evidence.quote: | NetEndOfMonth days -> DateOnly(issueDate.Year, issueDate.Month, DateTime.DaysInMonth(issueDate.Year, issueDate.Month)).AddDays days
| true, days when days > 0 && days <= 365 -> Ok(Some(NetEndOfMonth days))

ARC-REV-01.rationale: The due-date rule is in the Tier 1/2 `Summa.Ledger.Invoicing.dueDate`. The form parsing and range validation are in `Summa.Web.Engine` (Tier 2). Storage only encodes and decodes. Tier 3 and Tier 4 code is not touched.

ARC-REV-02.rationale: No new effect is introduced. `dueDate` is a pure function of the issue date and the terms. No clock, I/O or randomness is read, and `Int32.TryParse` uses the invariant culture.

ARC-REV-03.rationale: The `Net {days} EOM` wording is written twice, in `Documents.termsText` and in the audit-trail `termsWords`. The two copies agree. This follows the existing pattern for `Net`, but a shared text function would have given the fact one definition. The 1..365 limit is also restated in the new EOM branch, as it already was in the `Net` branch. The copies agree.

ARC-REV-01.rationale: The due-date rule and the ordinal wording are both in Tier 1/2 `Summa.Ledger`. Form parsing is in `Summa.Web.Engine`. Storage only decodes and validates the shape of the data. Tier 3 and Tier 4 decide nothing.

ARC-REV-02.rationale: All new code is pure: date arithmetic, string formatting, and parsing with the invariant culture. No effect is added below Tier 4 and no port is bypassed.

evidence.quote: if day >= 1 && day <= 28 then Ok(DayOfNextMonth day) else Error "A day of next month is from 1 to 28."
| true, day when day >= 1 && day <= 28 -> Ok(Some(DayOfNextMonth day))

ARC-REV-03.rationale: The ordinal text is defined once in `dayOfNextMonthText` and used by both `termsText` and `termsWords`. This fixes the wording duplication seen in change set 1. The 1..28 day limit is restated as a literal in the storage decoder and in the engine parser. The copies agree, but they could drift. The `Net {days} EOM` wording from change set 1 is still duplicated, though this change set did not add it.
